summary:
Frontend-only verification of the new on-client command indicator (data-testid='cmd-flash') alongside the existing privacy-overlay for the technician 'Black screen for controlled device' toggle in a normal browser (CI_NATIVE undefined path). All 4 requested checks PASSED with zero console errors on client or viewer.

Flow: Opened /conectar (client), captured session code via POST /api/public/support/connect (code=ba436ac4). Logged in as ADMIN euapostomesmo@proton.me, set localStorage 'invest_token' on the /crypto-invest origin, then navigated the viewer to /crypto-invest/sessao/ba436ac4.

Results:
- Toggle ON via [data-testid=ci-privacy-toggle]: client shows fullscreen [data-testid=privacy-overlay] with text 'Ajuste Técnico Aguarde…' AND [data-testid=cmd-flash] briefly showing '↳ Ecrã preto LIGADO' (bottom-left green pill).
- Toggle OFF: privacy-overlay removed from the client; cmd-flash re-appears showing '↳ Ecrã preto desligado'.
- Auto-hide: cmd-flash disappears within 2.6s (verified via 3s wait -> visible=False).
- Regression: [data-testid=ci-reconnect] on the viewer re-establishes signaling and the privacy toggle continues to work after reconnect (ON again produced overlay + flash).
- Console errors: 0 on client, 0 on viewer.
critical_code_review_comments: SuporteDispositivo.jsx L60-69: flashCmd() correctly labels privacy as 'Ecrã preto LIGADO/desligado' and auto-clears after 2.6s via cmdTimerRef; guarded against multiple stacked timers via clearTimeout.
SuporteDispositivo.jsx L144: flashCmd is invoked for all remote command types (gesture/text/key/nav/privacy) before native/local branching — good diagnostic coverage.

SuporteDispositivo.jsx L161-163: privacy branch falls back to setPrivacyLocal when window.CI_NATIVE?.available is falsy, so browser-only path (which is what the user reported broken on their real device) DOES render the visible black overlay + indicator here. If the toggle 'does nothing' on the real device, that means WS messages of type 'privacy' are never arriving at the client — the cmd-flash indicator is now the correct diagnostic (if no flash appears when the tech clicks, the signaling is the culprit, not the overlay renderer).

CryptoInvestViewer.jsx L24: togglePrivacy sends {type:'privacy',on} through wsRef only if readyState===1; if the WS is closed the message is silently dropped. Consider queueing until open or surfacing a viewer-side toast so the technician knows the toggle didn't reach the client.
Nit: cmd-flash pill uses green #4ADE80 on black — high contrast, but the up-arrow glyph '↳' is a returns marker; consider a neutral bullet or '→' for clarity.
Nit (carryover from iteration 8): stale anonymous sessions accumulate; consider upsert-by-device_id on POST /api/public/support/connect.
test_credentials: admin euapostomesmo@proton.me / Invest2026! (JWT stored in localStorage 'invest_token')
seed_data_creation: One anonymous support session created via /conectar registration this run: code=ba436ac4. Not deleted — main agent can remove it from the admin panel if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To acquire the client's session code deterministically, attach page.on('response') to catch POST /api/public/support/connect before or right after navigating to /conectar (then reload). Viewer requires an admin JWT in localStorage 'invest_token' on the same origin BEFORE navigating to /crypto-invest/sessao/{code}, otherwise CryptoInvestViewer redirects to /crypto-invest. To test cmd-flash timing note that the auto-hide is 2.6s — assertions should either check immediately after the WS round-trip (<1.2s) or wait >2.6s to assert hidden state. cmd-flash label mapping: gesture->'Arrasto'/'Toque', text->'Texto recebido', key->'Tecla {k}', nav->'Navegação', privacy->'Ecrã preto LIGADO/desligado'.
rca of the issue: User's report ('black screen toggle does nothing on their real device') is diagnosable now: the new cmd-flash indicator flashes for ANY remote command (privacy/gesture/text/key/nav) BEFORE the native/local branch. If the user does NOT see cmd-flash when the tech toggles, the WS 'privacy' message never arrives at the client (signaling issue: WS not connected as role=client, session mismatch, or Electron/Android build not opening presence WS). If cmd-flash DOES appear but the screen doesn't go black, the CI_NATIVE.control({action:'privacy'}) branch (Electron/Android bridge) is not honoring the command — a native-side bug outside browser scope. In the browser (verified here) both overlay and flash render correctly, so React/JSX/CSS path is proven healthy.
